req.title: Rate limit not enforced
req.statement: The system shall not throttle single-client request rates below 60/min.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-039 states the system shall NOT throttle single-client request rates below 60/min, meaning all 60 requests within a one-minute window must succeed with HTTP 2xx. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — 60 sequential GET /tasks/ requests all return 200; (2) boundary BVA — exactly 60 requests at the threshold all succeed (catches off-by-one on any rate-limit counter); (3) negative NEG — a single malformed request returns 4xx (422) confirming error-path handling is distinct from rate-limiting; (4) boundary BVA ±1 — 59 requests (threshold-1) all succeed; (5) DT — mix of GET and POST requests totalling 60 all return 2xx, confirming the limit applies per-client across endpoint types. All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient with exact status code assertions to kill comparison-operator and constant mutations.

tests.name: test_60_requests_all_succeed_positive
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
No rate limiting below 60 req/min is enforced
actions: Send exactly 60 GET /tasks/ requests sequentially using TestClient
expected: No response returns HTTP 429 or any 4xx/5xx
trace: R-TASK-039: system shall not throttle single-client request rates below 60/min
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_60_requests_all_succeed_positive():
    client = TestClient(app)
    responses = [client.get("/tasks/") for _ in range(60)]
    status_codes = [r.status_code for r in responses]
    assert len(status_codes) == 60
    for i, code in enumerate(status_codes):
        assert code == 200, f"Request {i+1} returned {code}, expected 200"
    assert all(c == 200 for c in status_codes)

test_60_requests_all_succeed_positive()

tests.name: test_exactly_60_requests_at_boundary_all_succeed
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
Rate limit threshold is 60 requests per minute
actions: Send exactly 60 GET /tasks/ requests (the boundary value)
expected: All 60 responses return HTTP 200 (boundary value must not be throttled)
trace: R-TASK-039: threshold is 60/min; at exactly 60 all must succeed — catches > vs >= mutation
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_exactly_60_requests_at_boundary_all_succeed():
    client = TestClient(app)
    RATE_LIMIT_THRESHOLD = 60
    responses = [client.get("/tasks/") for _ in range(RATE_LIMIT_THRESHOLD)]
    assert len(responses) == RATE_LIMIT_THRESHOLD
    success_count = sum(1 for r in responses if r.status_code == 200)
    assert success_count == RATE_LIMIT_THRESHOLD
    throttled_count = sum(1 for r in responses if r.status_code == 429)
    assert throttled_count == 0

test_exactly_60_requests_at_boundary_all_succeed()

tests.name: test_59_requests_below_threshold_all_succeed
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
Rate limit threshold is 60 requests per minute
expected: No throttling occurs below the threshold
trace: R-TASK-039: 59 < 60 must never be throttled — catches off-by-one mutation on limit constant
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_59_requests_below_threshold_all_succeed():
    client = TestClient(app)
    BELOW_THRESHOLD = 59
    responses = [client.get("/tasks/") for _ in range(BELOW_THRESHOLD)]
    assert len(responses) == BELOW_THRESHOLD
    for i, r in enumerate(responses):
        assert r.status_code == 200, f"Request {i+1} returned {r.status_code}"
    throttled = [r for r in responses if r.status_code != 200]
    assert len(throttled) == 0

test_59_requests_below_threshold_all_succeed()

tests.name: test_malformed_request_returns_4xx_not_rate_limit
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
POST /tasks/ requires a valid JSON body with title field
actions: Send a POST /tasks/ request with an empty body (missing required title)
Assert the response is 422 Unprocessable Entity
Confirm the error is a client validation error, not a rate-limit error
expected: Response is not 429 (rate limit) and not 200
trace: R-TASK-039 error pathway: HTTP 4xx on client error — distinguishes rate-limit 429 from validation 422
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_malformed_request_returns_4xx_not_rate_limit():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={})
    assert r.status_code == 422
    assert r.status_code != 429
    assert r.status_code != 200
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body

test_malformed_request_returns_4xx_not_rate_limit()

tests.name: test_mixed_endpoints_60_requests_all_succeed
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
Both GET /tasks/ and GET /tasks/{id} endpoints are available
actions: Send 30 GET /tasks/ requests and 30 GET /tasks/1 requests (60 total)
trace: R-TASK-039: rate limit applies per-client regardless of endpoint — DT covers multi-endpoint combination
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_mixed_endpoints_60_requests_all_succeed():
    client = TestClient(app)
    list_responses = [client.get("/tasks/") for _ in range(30)]
    item_responses = [client.get("/tasks/1") for _ in range(30)]
    all_responses = list_responses + item_responses
    assert len(all_responses) == 60
    list_codes = [r.status_code for r in list_responses]
    item_codes = [r.status_code for r in item_responses]
    assert all(c == 200 for c in list_codes), f"List codes: {list_codes}"
    assert all(c == 200 for c in item_codes), f"Item codes: {item_codes}"
    total_ok = sum(1 for r in all_responses if r.status_code == 200)
    assert total_ok == 60

test_mixed_endpoints_60_requests_all_succeed()

tests.name: test_response_body_valid_on_all_60_requests
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: Assert each returns status 200 and a JSON list of length 20
expected: Each response body is a list with exactly 20 items
No response is throttled or returns partial data
trace: R-TASK-039: not only must status be 2xx but response must be valid — catches mutations that return empty 200
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_response_body_valid_on_all_60_requests():
    client = TestClient(app)
    for i in range(60):
        r = client.get("/tasks/")
        assert r.status_code == 200, f"Request {i+1}: status {r.status_code}"
        body = r.json()
        assert isinstance(body, list), f"Request {i+1}: body not a list"
        assert len(body) == 20, f"Request {i+1}: expected 20 tasks, got {len(body)}"

test_response_body_valid_on_all_60_requests()
